hotel_name: Limewood Signature - Near Golf Course Road

positive_snippets:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at this hotel, and my experience was absolutely excellent. The rooms were clean, spacious, and very well-maintained. The bed was extremely comfortable, and all essential amenities such as air conditioning, Wi-Fi, television, and 24-hour hot water were available and working perfectly.

I would especially like to give special thanks to the manager Mr Yash Chaudhary, for his outstanding hospitality and professional behavior. He ensured that our stay was smooth and comfortable, making the experience even more memorable.

I would definitely recommend this hotel to my friends and family and look forward to staying here again in the future.

The bed was extremely cozy with clean and fresh linens, ensuring a great night’s sleep. All amenities such as air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, television, and 24-hour hot water worked perfectly without any issues.

The housekeeping service was prompt and efficient, keeping everything neat and well-organized throughout the stay. The room also had good lighting, proper ventilation, and a pleasant fragrance, which made the experience even better.
Overall, the rooms exceeded my expectations and made my stay truly comfortable and enjoyable. Highly recommended!
